findings.label: Row-cap counts all rows including header
findings.detail: _MAX_TABLE_ROWS caps all collected rows (header + data), so a sheet with <=200 total rows is never truncated and the header always survives; large sheets drop body rows past ~199 data rows. Behavior is correct and documented; the plan's '~200 data rows' is functionally equivalent. No action required.

findings.label: local_index increment placement in parse_docx
findings.detail: The reading-order index increments at the tail of each branch; verified monotonic and gap-free because every emitted block increments once and skipped empty paragraphs/empty tables do not. Cosmetic observation only; no action required.
